answer: Sybil farms collapse when admission is paid in delayed, locked credit. Each new identity must park a bond on a public terrace for six epochs before its attestations carry full weight. Meanwhile, rewards vest under a velvet lock and can be slashed if the key's answers or funding cluster with another identity. After six clean epochs the bond becomes a pearl credential that unlocks withdrawals. Spinning up 1,000 aliases ties up 1,000 bonds for six epochs against 150 POA of delayed pay, so the farm's capital sits idle while honest agents keep working on one key.
